verdict.rationale: Dots is operated conversationally. Users talk to it or type to it in ChatGPT, Slack, Teams, or on a voice call, and they give plain-language instructions such as recurring checks or bug investigations. Even control rules are created by describing the action. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language commands work reliably (all evidence is first-party docs), and some controls such as Pause and Take over are documented as UI buttons rather than spoken commands.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: You can keep talking to it while it works, and it reaches out with results or decisions that need you.
